```{r}
#| label: inject-sec-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (ssmsi_ready) {
  # Lissage Bayes empirique (Poisson-gamma) des taux : les petites communes ont des
  # taux très instables (1 fait = plusieurs ‰). Prior estimé par la méthode des moments,
  # séparément dans chacune des 6 classes de densité INSEE (voir eb_poisson_gamma()).
  # Événements = taux × population de référence SSMSI / 1000. Les cellules non publiées
  # (secret statistique) restent NA : on ne lisse que des valeurs publiées.
  dens_grp <- if (exists("densite_data")) densite_data$densite_rang[match(ssmsi_data$code_commune, densite_data$code_commune)] else NULL
  smooth_rate <- function(rate_pm, pop, group) {
    ok <- is.finite(rate_pm) & is.finite(pop) & pop > 0
    e <- eb_poisson_gamma(ifelse(ok, rate_pm * pop / 1000, NA_real_), ifelse(ok, pop, NA_real_), group)
    e$eb * 1000
  }
  pop_ref <- ssmsi_data$ssmsi_pop_ref
  sec_for_js <- ssmsi_data |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      code  = code_commune,
      pop   = pop_ref,
      camb  = round(del_cambriolages,     1),
      vehs  = round(del_vols_vehicules,   1),
      vols  = round(del_vols_pers,        1),
      viols = round(del_violences_sex,    1),
      degr  = round(del_degradations,     1),
      stup  = round(del_trafic_stup,      1),
      ucan  = round(del_usage_stup,       1),
      tot   = round(del_total_pour_mille, 1),
      acc   = if ("acc_pour_mille" %in% names(ssmsi_data)) round(acc_pour_mille, 2) else NA_real_,
      n_acc = if ("n_accidents_2024" %in% names(ssmsi_data)) n_accidents_2024 else NA_integer_,
      cambs  = round(smooth_rate(del_cambriolages,   pop_ref, dens_grp), 1),
      vehss  = round(smooth_rate(del_vols_vehicules, pop_ref, dens_grp), 1),
      volss  = round(smooth_rate(del_vols_pers,      pop_ref, dens_grp), 1),
      violss = round(smooth_rate(del_violences_sex,  pop_ref, dens_grp), 1),
      degrs  = round(smooth_rate(del_degradations,   pop_ref, dens_grp), 1),
      stups  = round(smooth_rate(del_trafic_stup,    pop_ref, dens_grp), 1),
      ucans  = round(smooth_rate(del_usage_stup,     pop_ref, dens_grp), 1),
      accs   = round(smooth_rate(acc_pour_mille,     pop_ref, dens_grp), 2)
    )
  emit_table("secData", sec_for_js)

  fields <- list(
    del_cambriolages  = list(key = "camb",  t = "Cambriolages"),
    del_vols_vehicules = list(key = "vehs", t = "Vols de véhicules"),
    del_vols_pers     = list(key = "vols",  t = "Vols de personnes"),
    del_violences_sex = list(key = "viols", t = "Violences sexuelles"),
    del_degradations  = list(key = "degr",  t = "Dégradations"),
    del_trafic_stup   = list(key = "stup",  t = "Trafic de stupéfiants"),
    del_usage_stup    = list(key = "ucan",  t = "Usage de stupéfiants"),
    acc_pour_mille    = list(key = "acc",   t = "Accidents corporels BAAC"),
    del_total_pour_mille = list(key = "tot", t = "Total des 13 postes")
  )
  fields <- lapply(fields, function(f) c(f, list(digits = if (f$key == "acc") 2L else 1L,
                                                  smooth = f$key != "tot")))

  cat('<script>\n',
      'window.secPalette = ', as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(PAL$red)), ';\n',
      'window.secFields = ', as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(fields, auto_unbox = TRUE)), ';\n',
      'window.secRecolor = function(field) {\n',
      '  var f = window.secFields[field] || window.secFields.del_cambriolages, vr = document.querySelector("input[name=sec-val]:checked"), sm = !!(vr && vr.value === "eb" && f.smooth);\n',
      '  var k = sm ? f.key + "s" : f.key, ttl = f.t + ", ‰ (échelle log" + (sm ? ", lissé" : "") + ")";\n',
      '  CMap.recolor({ get: function (c) { var r = window.secData[c]; return r ? r[k] : null; },\n',
      '    scale: "log_quantile", palette: window.secPalette,\n',
      '    legend: { title: ttl, unit: "‰", digits: f.digits, naLabel: "Non publié (secret statistique)",\n',
      '      note: sm ? "Taux lissé : moyenne pondérée entre le taux brut et la moyenne de la classe de densité INSEE (Bayes empirique)." : (f.key === "tot" ? "Le total n\\u2019existe que si les 13 postes sont publiés (685 communes)." : null) } });\n',
      '};\n',
      'window.secCurrentField = function () { var r = document.querySelector("input[name=sec-ind]:checked"); return r ? r.value : "del_cambriolages"; };\n',
      'window.updateSecPanel = function(code) {\n',
      '  var el = document.getElementById("sec-content");\n',
      '  if (!el) return;\n',
      '  var d = window.secData[code];\n',
      '  var elec = window.communeLookup && window.communeLookup[code];\n',
      '  var alt  = window.communeNames && window.communeNames[code];\n',
      '  var nom  = elec ? elec.nom_commune : (alt ? alt.nom : code);\n',
      '  var dept = elec ? (elec.libelle_dept + " (" + elec.code_dept + ")") : (alt ? ("Dépt " + alt.dept) : "");\n',
      '  if (!d) {\n',
      '    el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div><div class="dvf-empty">Aucun taux publié (secret stat ou commune absente du fichier SSMSI).</div>\';\n',
      '    return;\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  function fmt(x, n) { if (x == null) return "—"; return Number(x).toLocaleString("fr-FR", {minimumFractionDigits: n || 1, maximumFractionDigits: n || 1}); }\n',
      '  function row(label, raw, sm, n) {\n',
      '    return \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>\' + label + \'</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmt(raw, n) + \' ‰\' + (raw != null && sm != null ? \' <span class="cp-sm" title="Taux lissé (Bayes empirique)">→ \' + fmt(sm, n) + \'</span>\' : "") + \'</span></div>\';\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  var ev = (d.camb != null && d.pop) ? Math.round(d.camb * d.pop / 1000) : null;\n',
      '  el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Délinquance SSMSI 2025 · taux ‰ (brut → lissé)</h4>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kvs">\' +\n',
      '    row("Cambriolages", d.camb, d.cambs) +\n',
      '    row("Vols de véhicules", d.vehs, d.vehss) +\n',
      '    row("Vols de personnes", d.vols, d.volss) +\n',
      '    row("Dégradations", d.degr, d.degrs) +\n',
      '    row("Violences sexuelles", d.viols, d.violss) +\n',
      '    row("Trafic de stupéfiants", d.stup, d.stups) +\n',
      '    row("Usage de stupéfiants", d.ucan, d.ucans) +\n',
      '    row("Total (13 postes)", d.tot, null) +\n',
      '    \'</div><p class="cp-def">Population de référence : \' + (d.pop ? Number(d.pop).toLocaleString("fr-FR") : "—") + \' hab.\' + (ev != null ? " Cambriolages ≈ " + ev + " faits." : "") + \' Le taux lissé rapproche les petites communes de la moyenne de leur classe de densité ; il ne remplace pas le taux brut.</p></div>\' +\n',
      '    (d.acc != null ? \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Accidents corporels BAAC 2024</h4><div class="cp-kvs"><div class="cp-kv"><span>Nombre</span><span class="cp-num">\' + (d.n_acc != null ? d.n_acc : "—") + \'</span></div>\' + row("Taux", d.acc, d.accs, 2) + \'</div></div>\' : "");\n',
      '};\n',
      '</script>\n',
      sep = ""
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: map-sec
if (ssmsi_ready) {
  vals0 <- ssmsi_data |> dplyr::transmute(code_commune, value = del_cambriolages)
  st_sec <- cmap_breaks(vals0$value[vals0$code_commune %in% com_metro_only$code], "log_quantile")
  m <- cmap_choropleth(com_metro_only, dep_metro, vals0, palette = PAL$red,
                       legend_title = "Cambriolages, ‰ (échelle log)", unit = "‰", digits = 1L,
                       scale = "log_quantile", breaks = st_sec, na_label = "Non publié (secret statistique)")
  cmap_on_render(m, paste0(
    cmap_page_hooks("sec", "updateSecPanel", "sec-content", "sec-ind", "secRecolor", "del_cambriolages",
      ctx = list(ctx_spec("del_cambriolages", "Cambriolages", "‰", 1L), ctx_spec("del_vols_pers", "Vols de personnes", "‰", 1L),
                 ctx_spec("del_violences_sex", "Violences sexuelles", "‰", 1L), ctx_spec("del_degradations", "Dégradations", "‰", 1L),
                 ctx_spec("acc_taux_pop", "Accidents corporels", "‰", 2L)),
      ctx_title = "Repères : rang centile (communes publiées)"),
    "CMap.onRadios('sec-val', function () { window.secRecolor(window.secCurrentField()); });\n"))
} else {
  htmltools::HTML("<p class='js-loading'>SSMSI non chargé. Lancer Rscript scripts/07_ssmsi_dgfip.R.</p>")
}
```
:::

Lissage : Poisson-gamma, prior par classe de densité INSEE.
  </div>
</div>
